Every rank-one target and zero target were checked by direct finite-field multiplication in 27 parameter combinations; finite checks support but do not replace the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The exact all-length minimal-nilpotent-orbit fiber and alternating conditional mixing law are not implied by the fully inspected prior exact k=2 nilpotent orbit result, all-arity idempotent-class result, or classical qualitative matrix nilpotent factorization statements. Claim expressly excludes already known existence and two-factor cases.
residual_risks: Historical priority against unindexed semigroup random-walk treatments and obscure finite-field products remains unverified.

Sullivan, Products of nilpotent matrices (DOI 10.1080/03081080701269548), was accessible at abstract level but full text was not inspected; it discusses nilpotent factorization but exact-word-fiber overlap is not fully excluded.

The extension of k=2 and of the idempotent spectral method is related; value rests on the precise all-length trace-parity and conditional mixing invariant, not an assertion that the basic technique is new.

value.rationale: The minimal nilpotent conjugacy orbit is a canonical factor set; its all-length prescribed product fiber and survival/mixing statistics are natural unknown semigroup invariants. Exact alternating parity, the sharp length-two obstruction versus length-three saturation, and exponential conditional mixing go beyond the earlier two-factor counts. The qualitative length-three existence result was already known and is not presented as a novel theorem.
